assessment: In this manuscript, Phillips et al., have used several complementary in vivo and in vitro approaches to analyze the effects of regulated MAF1 expression or inhibition of RNA pol III transcription on osteogenesis and adipocyte differentiation. The data are well controlled and of excellent quality, providing novel insights into Maf1 and RNA polymerase-mediated transcriptions in skeleton biology.
